name: Intuition

abilities.text: Search your library for three cards and reveal them. Target opponent chooses one. Put that card into your hand and the rest into your graveyard. Then shuffle.

notes: The three cards are searched into hand and the two the opponent did not choose are then moved to the graveyard, which is the printed net result; `search` shuffles the library itself. The `scoped target-opponent` wrapper is what asks for the target — a family op's `chooser` word raises no target requirement of its own.

issues: Search your library for three cards — expected you may fail to find — scripted search count:3 without optional -> exact:true, so the harness requires exactly three picks; a player who wants to find fewer cannot. No name restriction is printed here, so nothing is dropped — CR 701.19c
